channel.title: The Dig — Gate and device benchmarking
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Gate and device benchmarking preset. Today’s ranked reading list is led by 2611.30931, a must-read on calibration-insensitive spin-qubit pulses that sustain 99.97% fidelity and stable rotation angles over ten days in Si/SiGe, directly targeting drift and recalibration. The remaining skims span adjacent practical concerns: 2611.32388 offers shallow-circuit thermal-state preparation ideas transferable mainly through depth reduction; 2611.30508 and 2611.32560 provide low-resource QAOA constructions and application heuristics relevant to small noisy spin-qubit benchmarks; 2611.29983 presents a calibration-aware compilation and backend stack but lacks spin-qubit and HPC evidence; and 2611.31514 frames DOE-scale HPC-quantum integration strategy without concrete spin-qubit control or middleware methods.
